Market today: Tech is still the main driver, and right now it's looking shaky. The headlines about widespread outages and "apocalyptic concerns" at Costco point to broader market jitters, which always hit growth names hard.
Your holdings: SMCI (-44.99%) and SOXL (-78.17%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. Given you're on margin, these leveraged ETFs are brutal. PLTU (-35.29%) and MU (-61.79%) are also bleeding.
Watch: Keep an eye on AVGO. It's showing up on the scanner with a decent setup.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your most painful positions and avoiding further downside.
plays: Trim SOXL if it breaks below its current price, given the massive loss and leverage.
Consider trimming SMCI if it shows no immediate signs of recovery.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
